svg.text: Tokeira Controller & Autoscaler — Concrete Coordination Model

text.tspan: Placement authority and scaling authority are separated. The bridge is not a private API: it is leases, metrics, heartbeats, and platform state.
Commit path is fenced by DSQL lease epoch.
Owns shard/bundle placement, routing snapshots, and connection-budget directives.
Singleton active controller; standby tasks attempt DSQL lease acquisition.
push full table to edge subscribers
Authoritative ownership record: bundle/shard owner + epoch.
Controller uses it for bundle leases; autoscaler uses ShardId(u32::MAX) only for leader election.
Autoscaler reads p95 latency, broker depth, poll success, runtime CPU, lane wait, and DSQL connection headroom via PromQL.
Turns metric evidence into desired service counts, runtime hosts, and safe retirements.
Only the elected leader runs loops; non-leaders sleep and retry.
DesiredState from loops A/B/C is compared to CurrentState read from ECS/ASG.
Produces ScalingAction values only when thresholds and hysteresis permit.

svg.text: platform-specific executor: ECS today; Kubernetes later
autoscaler may add/remove capacity, but only controller placement + DSQL epoch fencing define who may own and commit bundles.
